messages:
alex_customer: Hi team — noticed daily usage in Console shows different day totals than CSV export for our org. We're set to timezone Asia/Kathmandu (UTC+5:45). Charts show 2026-03-15 = 18.3k tokens but export CSV's 2026-03-15 has 12.1k and 2026-03-16 has 6.2k. Seems split around 05:15 UTC.

michelle_support: Sorry about that, can you paste a small sample of the CSV (dates + tokens) and a screenshot of the console tile? Also which report (daily UI vs export) did you compare? :mag:

alex_customer: here's snippet from export:
2026-03-15,12100
2026-03-16,6200

Console tile (hover) shows 2026-03-15 — 18300

We ran API queries for raw events: most events have timestamps like 2026-03-15T23:48:12Z and 2026-03-16T00:12:07Z — looks like our day boundary is being applied at 00:15 UTC somewhere.

michelle_support: Thanks. Assigning to @raj_sre to investigate ingestion/timezone bucketing.

raj_sre: I can take a look. Quick theory: ingestion pipeline truncates to day using DATE_TRUNC('day', timestamp) on the server's UTC-shifted time but then console applies org tz with minutes offset (Asia/Kathmandu +5:45). If truncation happens before applying tz offset, events between 00:00-00:05 UTC might move to previous day in org tz and cause split.

ollie_billing: This affects billing exports too? Customer says CSV export mismatches UI; billing jobs consume the same materialized view — pinging @karen_product.

karen_product: Noted — we need consistent semantics between UI tiles and exports. Can you repro locally with a couple of synthetic events?

raj_sre: Repro steps I'm running:
1) Insert two events: 2026-03-15T23:50:00Z and 2026-03-16T00:10:00Z
2) Materialized view currently does: DATE_TRUNC('day', event_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS day_utc
3) UI does: (day_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kathmandu' then formats date label

Problem: using DATE_TRUNC before applying the non-hour timezone (minutes offset) causes a mis-bucket for offsets that are not whole hours. Fix: perform timezone conversion first, then truncate: DATE_TRUNC('day', event_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kathmandu').

michelle_support: Can you push a quick patch for the materialized view and run backfill for the last 7 days? Customer needs reconciliation ASAP.

raj_sre: Will do — deploying change to staging, then backfill on production with low-priority job. ETA 2.5h including checks. I'll post progress.

deploy-bot: deploy started by raj_sre — mv_update/2026-03-17-ktz-fix

raj_sre: Patch applied to staging, counts align there. Scheduling prod run now.

ollie_billing: Heads up: backfill will reassign billing tiles. We'll avoid invoice churn by marking these as reconciliation adjustments and not re-billing customers for corrected rounding.

alex_customer: Thanks — appreciate quick response. Please ping when prod backfill completes.

raj_sre: Prod backfill finished. I rechecked 2026-03-15/16 totals and CSV now matches UI for Asia/Kathmandu org. Leaving monitoring job for 48h. If anything else, reopen.

michelle_support: Closing unless customer reports mismatch. :white_check_mark:

alex_customer: Confirmed — numbers match now. Much appreciated! :tada:
